name: Farside - Spatial Remote Workspace
summary: Remote systems, in your space. Farside brings remote desktop access and terminal sessions into your AR workspace on Meta Quest. Connect through RDP, VNC, and SSH to work with your computers and servers using one professional tool. Open a graphical desktop when you need the full interface, or use SSH when the command line is the right tool for the job. Farside is built for developers, system administrators, and IT professionals who want their remote systems within reach. Requires access to a host configured
